# Diligence Certification

> > Diligence Certification provides comprehensive regulatory compliance and certification services across BIS, CDSCO, CPCB, LMPC, ARAI, BEE, and other Indian regulatory bodies for product certification, business registration, and statutory approvals.

Diligence Certification specializes in helping manufacturers, importers, and businesses navigate India's complex regulatory landscape. The firm offers end-to-end certification support for ISI Mark, CRS Mark, medical devices, legal metrology, vehicle type approval, energy efficiency ratings, and EPR compliance, alongside business registration services for Indian and foreign entities.

## Key Topics

- BIS Certification (Bureau of Indian Standards)
- ISI Mark & CRS Mark
- CDSCO (Medical Device Regulation)
- Legal Metrology (LMPC)
- ARAI Vehicle Type Approval
- BEE Star Rating (Energy Efficiency)
- EPR Certification (Extended Producer Responsibility)
- CPCB Compliance
- Indian Standards (IS 13498:2017, IS 15489:2013, IS 7485:2018, IS 17264:2019, ISO 15480:2019)
- Product Certification & Compliance
- Regulatory Approval Services
- Business Registration in India
- WPC & TEC Certification
- DGCA & APEDA Approvals

## Core Certification Services

- [Legal Metrology Registration](https://www.diligencecertification.com/legal-metrology-registration): 5-step legal metrology registration service for weighing and measuring products via LMPC compliance
- [ARAI Vehicle Certification](https://www.diligencecertification.com/arai-vehicle-certification): ARAI vehicle type approval certification for automotive safety and emission compliance
- [BEE Star Rating Certification](https://www.diligencecertification.com/bee-star-rating-certification): BEE star rating certification for energy-efficient appliances and buildings
- [EPR Sustainable Packaging Certification](https://www.diligencecertification.com/epr-sustainable-packaging): EPR certification for sustainable packaging compliance and extended producer responsibility

## Medical Device & CDSCO Compliance

- [CDSCO Form 27 Guide](https://www.diligencecertification.com/understanding-cdsco-form-27): Comprehensive CDSCO Form 27 compliance guide for medical device manufacturers

## Business Registration & Corporate Services

- [Indian Subsidiary Company Registration](https://www.diligencecertification.com/indian-subsidiary-company): Foreign subsidiary company registration process and compliance requirements in India
- [Public Limited Company Formation](https://www.diligencecertification.com/public-limited-company): Public limited company registration process and compliance benefits
- [NGO Registration](https://www.diligencecertification.com/ngo-registration): NGO registration in India with timeline, documents, cost, and legal benefits

## BIS Product Certification Standards

- [Countersunk Flat Head Screws (IS 7485:2018)](https://www.diligencecertification.com/countersunk-flat-head-screws): BIS-certified flat head screws under IS 7485:2018 standard
- [Polyester Industrial Yarn (IS 17264:2019)](https://www.diligencecertification.com/bis-for-polyester-yarn): BIS certification for polyester industrial yarn under IS 17264:2019
- [Hexagon Washer Head Drilling Screws (ISO 15480:2019)](https://www.diligencecertification.com/hexagon-washer-head-drilling-screws): BIS-certified hexagon washer head drilling screws per ISO 15480:2019
